$comment: Animal Friends: First Boroughs (AF-STARTER-01). Authoritative card data for the prototype. Effects use the vocabulary interpreted by src/engine/effects.js; 'text' is the player-facing rules text, and a Statue's 'burden' is the drawback it imposes while controlled. The named cards are examples; the schema is the contract.
name: Animal Friends: First Boroughs

decks.name: Burrow & Bloom
decks.blurb: Rabbits and Mice of Agriculture and Lore: a warren that arrives in crowds and a records office that plays the Events nobody else can afford.

decks.name: Paws & Papers
decks.blurb: Raccoons and Foxes of Commerce and Civics: the City Dump is a second hand, and no auction closes without a Fox having read it first.

decks.name: Bramble & Bastion
decks.blurb: Hedgehogs and Badgers of Crafts and Agriculture: nothing moves them, nothing reaches them, and the shared shocks pass the town by.

decks.name: Ripple & Rune
decks.blurb: Otters and Squirrels of Lore and Commerce: work slides from paw to paw while the Supply quietly piles up somewhere safe.

decks.name: Whisker & Willow
decks.blurb: Cats and Mice of Lore and Crafts: the Cats act when they should not be able to, and the Mice have the paperwork ready either way.

decks.name: Root & Rampart
decks.blurb: Badgers and Rabbits of Civics and Crafts: a town meeting that never runs out of bodies and a wall that never comes down.

decks.name: Moon & Mocha
decks.blurb: Owls and Cats of Science and Commerce: the café never closes, the observatory never sleeps, and somebody has just been launched into space.

decks.name: Steam & Starlight
decks.blurb: Badgers and Owls of Crafts and Science: the boiler holds, the telescope is pointed the right way, and the whole works is up and running before dawn.

cards.name: Dabble
cards.title: River Pilot
cards.text: Hired from the Capital City; enters Busy. Busy: move a shift from one of your Characters to another, then gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: New in town, and already useful.

cards.name: Pip
cards.title: Chief Archivist
cards.text: Upgrades Pip. When Pip becomes upright, you may return an Event from your Town Dump to your hand, then look at the top two cards of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: Pip's archive has an answer for every argument the town has ever had, filed twice.

cards.name: Barrow
cards.title: Stonecutter
cards.text: Hired from the Capital City; enters Busy. Busy: brace for the next shared shock and gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: New in town, and already useful.

cards.name: Marlow
cards.title: Registrar General
cards.text: Upgrades Marlow. Your challenge bids win ties. Busy: the next Event you play this turn requires one fewer Character.
cards.flavor: Marlow has read every bylaw in the archive, and quotes them at the worst possible moments.

cards.name: Recession
cards.text: On reveal: every Character in both towns is sent to Unemployment. Goes to the City Dump.
cards.flavor: The ledgers close, the workshops darken, and every animal walks home the long way.

cards.name: Brook
cards.title: Riverwright
cards.text: Upgrades Brook. Whenever an opponent challenges one of your purchases, gain 2 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Brook builds the sturdiest docks on the river and never once raises her voice about it.

cards.name: Clover
cards.title: Master Botanist
cards.text: Upgrades Clover. At the start of your turn, if you control another Agriculture Character, gain 2 Supply.
cards.flavor: Every garden in three boroughs owes something to a cutting Clover once gave away.

cards.name: Thimble
cards.title: Warren Runner
cards.text: Hired from the Capital City; enters Busy. When Thimble is recruited, you may recruit a Character costing 1 or less from your hand; it enters Busy.
cards.flavor: New in town, and already useful.

cards.name: Comet
cards.title: Astronaut
cards.text: When Comet becomes upright, look at the top three cards of the Market Deck and gain 1 Supply. Busy, once per game: Comet readies herself.
cards.flavor: From up here the Capital City is a very small market with very small bidding. She waves anyway.

cards.name: Thimble
cards.title: Quilt Maker
cards.text: Upgrades Thimble. When Thimble becomes upright, nobody's Characters advance at the next Ready.
cards.flavor: No scrap is too small to keep somebody warm.

cards.name: Tansy
cards.title: Town Historian
cards.text: Busy: move a shift from one of your Characters to another, then gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Tansy set down the lamplighter's pole to write the town's story instead.

cards.name: Acorn
cards.title: Stall Runner
cards.text: Busy: take every Supply your Characters have put by.
cards.flavor: Acorn can be at three stalls at once, and usually is.

cards.name: Tansy
cards.title: Lamplighter
cards.text: Busy: ready one of your Characters.
cards.flavor: She knows which street will want light before the dusk does.

cards.name: Inkwell
cards.title: Night Librarian
cards.text: Upgrades Inkwell. When Inkwell becomes upright, nobody's Characters advance at the next Ready.
cards.flavor: A good story always leaves room for one more listener.

cards.name: Pippa
cards.title: Moon Gardener
cards.text: Upgrades Pippa. When Pippa becomes upright, gain 1 Supply; if you control Comet, draw 1 card as well.
cards.flavor: The moon, it turns out, is excellent for radishes.

cards.name: Backroom Deal
cards.text: Requires a Raccoon, a Fox, and a Commerce Character. Gain 3 Supply, draw 2 cards, and send one opposing Character with cost 1 or less to Unemployment.
cards.flavor: Everyone signs, everyone smiles, and somebody quietly loses their chair.

cards.name: Acorn
cards.title: Guild Broker
cards.text: Upgrades Acorn. When an opponent challenges one of your purchases, gain 2 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Every challenge is just another fee, politely collected.

cards.name: Thistle
cards.title: Grange Elder
cards.text: Upgrades Thistle. At the start of your turn, if you have no more Characters in Unemployment than your opponent, gain 2 Supply.
cards.flavor: Thistle has buried three winters' worth of worry and still gets up before the lanterns.

cards.name: Sage
cards.title: Royal Astronomer
cards.text: At the start of your turn, look at the top two cards of your deck and put any of them on the bottom, then draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: The Crown wanted to know when the comet would come. Sage told them to the minute, and then went back to bed.

cards.name: Hazel
cards.title: Merchant
cards.text: Upgrades Hazel. Whenever you gain a non-Statue Market card, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Hazel has become a trusted merchant of all the land.

cards.name: The Festival Green
cards.title: Capital City Building
cards.text: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: It was here before this Mayor, and it will be here after.

cards.name: Moss
cards.title: Bridgewright
cards.text: Upgrades Moss. Busy: ready one of your Characters.
cards.flavor: Three boroughs, one river, and Moss’s stubborn arches between them.

cards.name: Barley
cards.title: Town Recorder
cards.text: Upgrades Barley. At the start of your turn, if you control a Rabbit Character, gain 2 Supply.
cards.flavor: Barley's ledgers hold the whole town's promises, kept and otherwise.

cards.name: Apprentice School
cards.title: Capital City Building
cards.text: At the start of your turn, you may ready one Apprentice. Your Masters enter play with one fewer orientation delay.
cards.flavor: It was here before this Mayor, and it will be here after.

cards.name: The Observatory
cards.title: Capital City Building
cards.text: At the start of your turn, look at the top two cards of the Market Deck and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: A brass dome, a long cold staircase, and the best view in the boroughs of what everybody else is about to do.

cards.name: Quill
cards.title: Town Scrivener
cards.text: Hired from the Capital City; enters Busy. When Quill becomes upright, you may return an Event from your Town Dump to your hand.
cards.flavor: New in town, and already useful.

cards.name: Dill
cards.title: Herbalist Surgeon
cards.text: Upgrades Dill. When Dill becomes upright, you may rehire a Character from your Unemployment for 1 less Supply; if you control Fern, draw 1 card as well.
cards.flavor: Dill's remedies are half herb and half Fern's field notes, and she credits both.

cards.name: Nib
cards.title: Master Cartographer
cards.text: Upgrades Nib. When Nib becomes upright, look at the top three cards of your deck and put them back in any order, then look at the top two cards of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: Nib's maps show where the canals go and, in the margins, where the money does.

cards.name: Willow
cards.title: Harbour Admiral
cards.text: Upgrades Willow. Whenever you gain a non-Statue Capital City card, gain 2 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Willow started with one ferry. She now signs for everything that floats.

cards.name: Linnet
cards.title: Master Printer
cards.text: Upgrades Linnet. Busy: draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: The press runs all night, and by morning the whole borough is reading the same page.

cards.name: Nutmeg
cards.title: Festival Florist
cards.text: Upgrades Nutmeg. Busy: take every Supply your Characters have put by.
cards.flavor: When the Capital City throws a festival, every garland on the square is Nutmeg's.

cards.name: Pebble
cards.title: Harbour Warden
cards.text: Upgrades Pebble. At the start of your turn, if you control Characters of at least three species, gain 2 Supply.
cards.flavor: A harbour with one kind of boat in it, Pebble says, is a harbour waiting to be a pond.

cards.name: Oakley
cards.title: Stonemason
cards.text: When Oakley becomes upright, you may rehire a Character from your Unemployment for 2 less Supply.
cards.flavor: Oakley sets a foundation stone the way other folk shake hands.

cards.name: Quill
cards.title: Harvest Steward
cards.text: Upgrades Quill. Your Masters arrive one turn sooner.
cards.flavor: Quill has the whole harvest planned before the first frost lifts.

cards.name: Mabel
cards.title: Seed Bank Director
cards.text: Upgrades Mabel. Once per turn, an Event you play requires one fewer Character. (This does not stack with the Statue of Ingenuity.)
cards.flavor: Mabel has a seed for every soil and a form for every seed, and somehow the town loves her for it.

cards.name: Clover
cards.title: Community Gardener
cards.text: Upgrades Clover. When Clover is recruited, you may recruit a Character costing 1 or less from your hand; it enters Busy.
cards.flavor: Clover transforms a meadow into a lush, thriving garden.

cards.name: Bean
cards.title: Café Proprietor
cards.text: At the start of your turn, one of your other Characters turns one step toward upright.
cards.flavor: The All-Night Café has no closing time, no menu and no chairs that match. It has never once been empty.

cards.name: Brook
cards.title: Balloonist
cards.text: Upgrades Brook. When Brook becomes upright, look at the top two cards of the Market Deck and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: From up there the whole river looks like a piece of string somebody dropped.

cards.name: Moss
cards.title: Guild Architect
cards.text: When Moss becomes upright, you may rehire a Character from your Unemployment for 2 less Supply.
cards.flavor: Moss draws the plans now and lets younger paws swing the hammer.

cards.name: Bramble
cards.title: Guild Warden
cards.text: Upgrades Bramble. At the start of your turn, if you control another Crafts Character, gain 1 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: The tinker who fixed everyone's kettles now keeps the guild's keys, and still fixes the kettles.

cards.name: Bram
cards.title: Journeyman Carter
cards.text: Hired from the Capital City; enters Busy. At the start of your turn, your town braces: the next shared shock passes it over.
cards.flavor: New in town, and already useful.

cards.name: Mortar
cards.title: Watermill Mechanic
cards.text: When Mortar becomes upright, you may rehire a Character from your Unemployment for 2 less Supply.
cards.flavor: He listens to the wheel until the wheel sounds happy.

cards.name: Pockets
cards.title: Salvage Raccoon
cards.text: Hired from the Capital City; enters Busy. Busy: take a Market card from the City Dump and gain it.
cards.flavor: New in town, and already useful.

cards.name: Hazel
cards.title: Guildmaster
cards.text: Busy: take a Market card from the City Dump and gain it.
cards.flavor: Hazel closed the stall and opened the guild hall instead; the haggling never really stopped.

cards.name: Patch
cards.title: Town Auditor
cards.text: Upgrades Patch. Busy: take a Market card from the City Dump and gain it.
cards.flavor: Patch keeps the town's affairs honest and balanced.

cards.name: Linnet
cards.title: Lending Librarian
cards.text: Upgrades Linnet. Busy: ready another Rabbit you control.
cards.flavor: A full shelf, Linnet insists, is a shelf that is about to earn its keep.

cards.name: Acorn
cards.title: Trade Envoy
cards.text: Busy: take every Supply your Characters have put by.
cards.flavor: Acorn represents three guilds at once and somehow keeps all three happy.

cards.name: Flint
cards.title: Peddler
cards.text: When you announce a purchase, add 1 Supply to it and look at the top card of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: Flint can sell you back your own umbrella and make it feel like a bargain.

cards.name: Copper
cards.title: Scale Polisher
cards.text: When Copper is recruited, your Characters advance an extra step at your next Ready.
cards.flavor: An honest measure makes a lasting friendship.

cards.name: Marmalade
cards.title: Dough Kneader
cards.text: When Marmalade is recruited, your Characters advance an extra step at your next Ready.
cards.flavor: The first loaf is always for a neighbor.

cards.name: Velvet
cards.title: Petition Runner
cards.text: When Velvet is recruited, your Characters advance an extra step at your next Ready.
cards.flavor: Every pawprint deserves a place in the town record.

cards.name: Patch
cards.title: Guild Investigator
cards.text: Upgrades Patch. Whenever a card effect sends any Character to Unemployment, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Patch has a nose for a story that somebody would rather stayed buried.

cards.name: Clover
cards.title: Rocket Botanist
cards.text: Upgrades Clover. Recruit: you may recruit a Character costing 1 or less from your hand for free; it enters Busy.
cards.flavor: Potatoes will grow anywhere, she says, if you ask them nicely. Even up there.

cards.name: Mittens
cards.title: Rooftop Cat
cards.text: Hired from the Capital City; enters Busy. Busy, once per game: Mittens readies itself.
cards.flavor: New in town, and already useful.

cards.name: Juniper
cards.title: Diplomat
cards.text: Upgrades Juniper. Your opponent cannot raise a pending bid.
cards.flavor: Juniper brings understanding and peace between old friends.

cards.name: Tansy
cards.title: Loremaster
cards.text: Upgrades Tansy. At the start of your turn, draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: Tansy reads the town the way a river reads its own banks.

cards.name: Inkwell
cards.title: Ledger Scribe
cards.text: Upgrades Inkwell. When Inkwell becomes upright, nobody's Characters advance at the next Ready.
cards.flavor: Inkwell copies the market ledgers by night and remembers every entry by morning.

cards.name: Velvet
cards.title: Notary
cards.text: Upgrades Velvet. When Velvet becomes upright, nobody's Characters advance at the next Ready.
cards.flavor: Velvet reads the small print aloud, slowly, and watches who fidgets.

cards.name: Fern
cards.title: Ecologist
cards.text: Upgrades Fern. The first Event you play each turn also gives you 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Fern understands the woodland's deepest rhythms and needs.

cards.name: Tuppence
cards.title: Market Squirrel
cards.text: Hired from the Capital City; enters Busy. When Tuppence completes a shift, put 2 Supply by on Tuppence.
cards.flavor: New in town, and already useful.

cards.name: Nim
cards.title: Page Runner
cards.text: When Nim completes a shift, put 1 Supply by on Nim.
cards.flavor: Nim can find any book in the library, provided you don't ask which shelf.

cards.name: Pebble
cards.title: Ferry Master
cards.text: Upgrades Pebble. Busy: move a shift from one of your Characters to another.
cards.flavor: Pebble ran letters across the bridge for years; now the bridge runs to her schedule.

cards.name: Grain Exchange
cards.title: Capital City Building
cards.text: At the start of your turn, gain 2 Supply.
cards.flavor: It was here before this Mayor, and it will be here after.

cards.name: Juniper
cards.title: Messenger
cards.text: When you announce a purchase, look at the top 2 cards of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: No letter is too urgent for a Fox with quick paws and a quicker grin.

cards.name: Marmalade
cards.title: Harvest Head Baker
cards.text: Upgrades Marmalade. The first time Marmalade completes a shift each turn, gain 1 extra Supply.
cards.flavor: The first loaf is always for a neighbor.

cards.name: Thimble
cards.title: Master of Mending
cards.text: Upgrades Thimble. Busy: choose another Character you control; it becomes upright at the start of your next turn.
cards.flavor: No scrap is too small to keep somebody warm.

cards.name: Pip
cards.title: Travelling Storyteller
cards.text: Upgrades Pip. When Pip becomes upright, look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.
cards.flavor: Pip tells stories at every market from here to the Capital, and hears twice as many back.

cards.name: Marlow
cards.title: Lamplighter’s Clerk
cards.text: Upgrades Marlow. When Marlow becomes upright, you may return an Event from your Town Dump to your hand.
cards.flavor: Files by lamplight, so the lamps are always filed.

cards.name: Nutmeg
cards.title: Bouquet Weaver
cards.text: When Nutmeg becomes upright, look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.
cards.flavor: Even the busiest stall has room for flowers.

cards.name: Marlow
cards.title: Ward Clerk
cards.text: When Marlow completes a shift, you may return an Event from your Town Dump to your hand.
cards.flavor: Marlow stamps every form twice, just to be sure.

cards.name: Mabel
cards.title: Seed Bank Clerk
cards.text: The first Event you play each turn lets you draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Mabel keeps every packet labelled, dated, and exactly where she said it would be.

cards.name: Hiring Hall
cards.title: Capital City Building
cards.text: At the start of your turn, you may rehire a Character from your Unemployment for 2 less Supply.
cards.flavor: It was here before this Mayor, and it will be here after.

cards.name: Landslide
cards.text: On reveal: every shift in progress in both towns ends at once and produces nothing, and at each Mayor's next Ready their Characters do not advance. Goes to the City Dump.
cards.flavor: Half the hillside comes down across the low road, and every errand in town waits a day.

cards.name: Pip
cards.title: Natural Philosopher
cards.text: Upgrades Pip. When Pip becomes upright, look at the top three cards of your deck and put them back in any order, then put 1 Supply by on Pip.
cards.flavor: “Why?” is the whole job. “Because” is the pension.

cards.name: Hazel
cards.title: Market Vendor
cards.text: When Hazel completes a shift, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Hazel arranges her market stall with care and pride.

cards.name: Salvage Yard
cards.title: Capital City Building
cards.text: At the start of your turn, you may take a Market card from the City Dump and gain it.
cards.flavor: It was here before this Mayor, and it will be here after.

cards.name: Barley
cards.title: Ledger Boy
cards.text: When Barley is recruited, your town braces: the next shared shock passes it over.
cards.flavor: Barley keeps the borough's books balanced down to the last acorn.

cards.name: Bramble
cards.title: Guild Apprentice Master
cards.text: While Bramble is in town, your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment by an opponent.
cards.flavor: Bramble takes on three apprentices a season and loses patience with none of them.

cards.name: Quill
cards.title: Orchard Keeper
cards.text: While Quill is in town, your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment by an opponent.
cards.flavor: She prunes the orchard the way other folk tidy a bookshelf.

cards.name: Juniper
cards.title: Stargazer
cards.text: Upgrades Juniper. At the start of your turn, look at the top two cards of the Market Deck; if you control another Science Character, gain 1 Supply as well.
cards.flavor: A diplomat knows the sky is the one thing everybody shares. She has drafted a treaty about it.

cards.name: Tansy
cards.title: Lantern Maker
cards.text: Upgrades Tansy. Busy: ready one of your Characters.
cards.flavor: Tansy makes the lanterns and Vesper carries them, and between them the night shift never stumbles.

cards.name: Dill
cards.title: Apothecary
cards.text: Upgrades Dill. Busy: return an Event from your Town Dump to your hand.
cards.flavor: Dill closes the shop each night by tidying every jar back into its proper place.

cards.name: Fern
cards.title: Wildlife Warden
cards.text: Busy: return an Event from your Town Dump to your hand.
cards.flavor: Fern reads a hedgerow the way other folk read a letter from home.

cards.name: Nib
cards.title: Star Charter
cards.text: Upgrades Nib. Busy: the next Event you play requires one fewer Character.
cards.flavor: The map of the sky is the only map with nobody on it yet.

cards.name: Russet
cards.title: Coffee Roaster
cards.text: Upgrades Russet. Busy: gain 1 Supply, then you may pay 2 Supply to raise one of your open bids by 2.
cards.flavor: Strong enough to bid on. Hot enough to regret it.

cards.name: Sorrel
cards.title: Night Harvester
cards.text: Upgrades Sorrel. Recruit: you may recruit a Character costing 1 or less from your hand for free; it enters Busy.
cards.flavor: Harvest does not stop for dark. Neither does Sorrel, mostly.

cards.name: The Long Hall
cards.title: Capital City Building
cards.text: At the start of your turn, ready one of your Characters.
cards.flavor: It was here before this Mayor, and it will be here after.

cards.name: Bean
cards.title: Barista
cards.text: When Bean becomes upright, one of your other Characters turns one step toward upright.
cards.flavor: Latte art in the shape of whoever is being slowest this morning.

cards.name: Clover
cards.title: Seedling Helper
cards.text: When Clover is recruited, you may recruit a Character costing 1 or less from your hand; it enters Busy.
cards.flavor: Small paws, big watering can, and the first green shoots of spring.

cards.name: Sorrel
cards.title: Sprout Tender
cards.text: When Sorrel is recruited, if you control another Rabbit, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Sorrel talks to the seedlings and swears they listen.

cards.name: Patch
cards.title: Salvage Foreman
cards.text: Upgrades Patch. When Patch completes a shift, you may return an Event from your Town Dump to your hand.
cards.flavor: Nothing is wasted at Patch's yard, least of all a sudden vacancy.

cards.name: Willow
cards.title: Tide Reckoner
cards.text: Upgrades Willow. When Willow becomes upright, another Character you control becomes upright at the start of your next turn.
cards.flavor: The tide tables are right to the minute. The harbour runs to Willow’s minute, not the tide’s.

cards.name: Nim
cards.title: Reference Librarian
cards.text: Upgrades Nim. When Nim becomes upright, look at the top three cards of your deck and put them back in any order.
cards.flavor: Nim has read every book in the annex and remembers exactly where the good parts are.

cards.name: Mortar
cards.title: Master Millwright
cards.text: Upgrades Mortar. The first shift you complete each turn produces 1 extra Supply.
cards.flavor: Every gear in the borough turns a little truer once Mortar has had a look at it.

cards.name: Second Founding
cards.text: Gain 5 Supply, draw 2 cards, and ready one of your Characters.
cards.flavor: The town rebuilds itself louder and stranger than before, and somehow it works.

cards.name: Mabel
cards.title: Horticulturist
cards.text: Upgrades Mabel. The first Event you play each turn lets you draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Mabel knows the secret language of all growing things.

cards.name: Mortar
cards.title: Steam Engineer
cards.text: Upgrades Mortar. When Mortar becomes upright, your town braces: the next shared shock passes it over.
cards.flavor: The boiler has never once exploded. He is very proud of the "once".

cards.name: Burr
cards.title: Whittler
cards.text: When Burr is recruited, Burr cannot be targeted by an opponent's effect until your next turn.
cards.flavor: Burr's pocketknife has carved half the toys in the nursery.

cards.name: The Old Wall
cards.title: Capital City Building
cards.text: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Supply. Your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment by an opponent.
cards.flavor: It was here before this Mayor, and it will be here after.

cards.name: Tawny
cards.title: Headmistress
cards.text: The first Event you play each turn lets one of your other Characters turn one step toward upright.
cards.flavor: Headmistress of the Night School, and of the day school, which she runs by leaving notes.

cards.name: Oakley
cards.title: Town Planner
cards.text: Upgrades Oakley. Busy: your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment until your next turn.
cards.flavor: Oakley drew the new town square from a foundation stone she laid herself, decades back.

cards.name: Rowan
cards.title: Ombudsperson
cards.text: Upgrades Rowan. Busy: until your next turn, your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment.
cards.flavor: Rowan ensures everyone's voice is heard and honored.

cards.name: Bramble
cards.title: Master Joiner
cards.text: Upgrades Bramble. While Bramble is in town, your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment by an opponent.
cards.flavor: Every beam in the new town hall fits without a single nail.

cards.name: Russet
cards.title: Tea House Keeper
cards.text: Upgrades Russet. At the start of your turn, if you control a Cat, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: The tea house is where the borough's business really gets done, and Russet pours for all of it.

cards.name: Oakley
cards.title: Bridge Engineer
cards.text: Upgrades Oakley. At the start of your turn, if you control a Crafts Character, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Measure twice, dig once, and never trust a river that looks calm.

cards.name: Sage
cards.title: Astronomer
cards.text: When Sage becomes upright, look at the top card of the Market Deck, then look at the top two cards of your deck and put any of them on the bottom.
cards.flavor: Sage sees the dawn coming an hour before anybody else, and makes very sure they know about it.

cards.name: Clover’s Potato Experiment
cards.text: Requires Clover and an Agriculture Character. Gain 3 Supply, then you may recruit a Character costing 1 or less from your hand for free; it enters Busy.
cards.flavor: Hypothesis: potatoes. Method: potatoes. Conclusion: more potatoes than expected.

cards.name: Nim
cards.title: Chancellor of Records
cards.text: Upgrades Nim. At the start of your turn, if you control Pip, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Nim files what Pip collects. Between them, nothing that happens in town is ever quite forgotten.

cards.name: Moss
cards.title: Rocketwright
cards.text: Upgrades Moss. When Moss becomes upright, if you control Comet, gain 2 Supply.
cards.flavor: Comet asked for “more boom”. Moss has notes.

cards.name: Inkwell
cards.title: Bookmark Keeper
cards.text: When Inkwell is recruited, your Characters advance an extra step at your next Ready.
cards.flavor: A good story always leaves room for one more listener.

cards.name: Fern
cards.title: Forager
cards.text: When Fern is recruited, your next Event needs one fewer Character.
cards.flavor: Fern ventures into the forest, gathering nature's gifts.

cards.name: Barley
cards.title: Geologist
cards.text: Upgrades Barley. Recruit: if you control another Badger, gain 2 Supply.
cards.flavor: It is rocks, all the way down. He checked.

cards.name: Dill
cards.title: Research Chemist
cards.text: Upgrades Dill. Recruit: you may return an Event from your Town Dump to your hand.
cards.flavor: Every experiment is a recipe that has not worked yet.

cards.name: Juniper
cards.title: Courier Captain
cards.text: While Juniper is upright, your first bid each turn counts as 1 higher.
cards.flavor: Juniper still runs the fastest route in town, just with better maps now.

cards.name: Russet
cards.title: Tea Trader
cards.text: While Russet is upright, your first bid each turn counts as 1 higher.
cards.flavor: There is always a spare cup behind the counter.

cards.name: Quill
cards.title: Orchard Scribe
cards.text: Upgrades Quill. When Quill starts a shift, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Quill writes down which tree fruited when, and the orchard has never had a bad year since.

cards.name: The Great Reshuffle
cards.text: Each Mayor sends two Characters of their choice to Unemployment.
cards.flavor: The Mayors agreed that everything would be more efficient afterwards. It was not.

cards.name: Nim
cards.title: Night Archivist
cards.text: Upgrades Nim. When Nim becomes upright, look at the top two cards of your deck and put them back in any order.
cards.flavor: Files the day away while it is still warm.

cards.name: Copper
cards.title: Weights Inspector
cards.text: Upgrades Copper. When Copper is recruited, your Characters advance an extra step at your next Ready.
cards.flavor: Nobody argues with Copper's scales, least of all the merchants who used to lean on them.

cards.name: Marmalade
cards.title: Market Baker
cards.text: Upgrades Marmalade. When Marmalade is recruited, your Characters advance an extra step at your next Ready.
cards.flavor: The first tray sells before the oven is even warm.

cards.name: Pippa
cards.title: Conservatory Keeper
cards.text: Upgrades Pippa. When Pippa is recruited, your Characters advance an extra step at your next Ready.
cards.flavor: Every windowsill can become a small garden.

cards.name: Inkwell
cards.title: Astronomer
cards.text: Upgrades Inkwell. When Inkwell completes a shift, look at the top two cards of the Market Deck. Busy, once per game: Inkwell readies himself.
cards.flavor: The stars keep cat hours. It is the one thing about them Inkwell respects.

cards.name: Velvet
cards.title: Registrar of Stars
cards.text: Upgrades Velvet. When you announce a purchase with Velvet, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Names every star after a form she has filed. There are a great many stars and rather more forms.

cards.name: Barley
cards.title: Warren Surveyor
cards.text: Upgrades Barley. When Barley becomes upright, you may rehire a Character from your Unemployment for 2 less Supply.
cards.flavor: Barley maps every burrow in the borough and still knocks before entering.

cards.name: Tawny
cards.title: Night School Teacher
cards.text: Recruit: one of your other Characters turns one step toward upright.
cards.flavor: Lessons begin at ten. Nobody is sure ten what.

cards.name: Brook
cards.title: Ferry Hand
cards.text: When Brook is recruited, another Character you control is upright at the start of your next turn.
cards.flavor: Brook picked up every story the river carried, and passes them all along.

cards.name: Willow
cards.title: Toll Keeper
cards.text: When Willow is recruited, another Character you control is upright at the start of your next turn.
cards.flavor: Willow moved from the ferry to the tollhouse, and still knows everyone's business.

cards.name: Copper
cards.title: Market Steward
cards.text: Upgrades Copper. The first time Copper announces a purchase each turn, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: An honest measure makes a lasting friendship.

cards.name: Inkwell
cards.title: Keeper of Stories
cards.text: Upgrades Inkwell. The first Event you play each turn that requires Lore lets you draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: A good story always leaves room for one more listener.

cards.name: Fern
cards.title: Field Recorder
cards.text: Upgrades Fern. When Fern is recruited, your next Event needs one fewer Character.
cards.flavor: Every festival, flood and first frost goes into Fern's notebook in tiny, tidy handwriting.

cards.name: Patch
cards.title: Junkyard Inventor
cards.text: Upgrades Patch. Busy: take a Market card from the City Dump and gain it.
cards.flavor: One Mayor’s rubbish is another Mayor’s rocket.

cards.name: Barnaby
cards.title: Night Auditor
cards.text: Hired from the Capital City; enters Busy. At the start of your turn, look at the top two cards of your deck and put any of them on the bottom.
cards.flavor: A barn owl with a ledger. The ledger is always right, which is more than can be said for the barn.

cards.name: Velvet
cards.title: Guild Speaker
cards.text: Upgrades Velvet. While Velvet is upright, your first bid each turn counts as 1 higher.
cards.flavor: Every pawprint deserves a place in the town record.

cards.name: Poppy
cards.title: Mail Coach Driver
cards.text: Upgrades Poppy. The first time you announce a purchase each turn, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: The coach leaves on the hour whether the passengers are aboard or not. Poppy considers this a kindness.

cards.name: Bean
cards.title: Espresso Puller
cards.text: Busy: one of your other Characters turns one step toward upright.
cards.flavor: One cup and the whole workshop is awake. Two cups and it is arguing about the shelving.

cards.name: Clover
cards.title: Market Gardener
cards.text: Upgrades Clover. Busy: ready another Rabbit you control.
cards.flavor: Clover sells the surplus at the Saturday stall and comes home with more seeds than coins.

cards.name: Burr
cards.title: Kite Tester
cards.text: Upgrades Burr. Recruit: if you control another Science Character, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: It flew. Briefly. Downward.

cards.name: Pip
cards.title: Archivist
cards.text: Upgrades Pip. When Pip becomes upright, look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.
cards.flavor: Nothing is ever really lost; it is only filed somewhere clever.

cards.name: Pebble
cards.title: Night Ferry
cards.text: Busy: move a shift from one of your Characters to another.
cards.flavor: Last boat at midnight. First boat at midnight and five minutes.

cards.name: Willow
cards.title: Harbourmaster
cards.text: Upgrades Willow. When Willow is recruited, another Character you control is upright at the start of your next turn.
cards.flavor: Every crate on the quay has already been counted by Willow.

cards.name: Founders' Orchard
cards.text: Requires a Rabbit, a Mouse, and a Agriculture Character. Draw 2 cards, gain 3 Supply, and ready one of your Characters.
cards.flavor: Three kinds of paws planted this orchard, and all three come home to it.

cards.name: Pippa
cards.title: Herb Cook
cards.text: Upgrades Pippa. Busy, once per game: Pippa readies itself.
cards.flavor: Pippa grows the rosemary; Marmalade bakes it into everything. The queue starts at dawn.

cards.name: Comet
cards.title: Test Pilot
cards.text: Busy, once per game: Comet readies herself.
cards.flavor: The test was: does it go up. It went up. The second test was: does it come down. Results pending.

cards.name: Vesper
cards.title: Weather Watcher
cards.text: Upgrades Vesper. When Vesper starts a shift, look at the top two cards of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: Red sky at night, Foxes’ delight. Red sky in the morning, somebody is bidding.

cards.name: Poppy
cards.title: Civic Planner
cards.text: Upgrades Poppy. Your challenge bids win ties.
cards.flavor: Poppy shapes the town's future with her wise decisions.

cards.name: Burr
cards.title: Cabinetmaker
cards.text: Upgrades Burr. While Burr is in town, your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment by an opponent.
cards.flavor: Burr's joints hold without a single nail, and he'll tell you so if you let him.

cards.name: Quill
cards.title: Seed Vault Keeper
cards.text: While Quill is in town, your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment by an opponent.
cards.flavor: Quill has moved from orchard to vault, but she still prunes everything she touches.

cards.name: Vesper
cards.title: Keeper of Tales
cards.text: Upgrades Vesper. When you announce a purchase, look at the top 2 cards of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: Vesper trades stories with every otter on the river and forgets none of them.

cards.name: Pippa
cards.title: Glasshouse Curator
cards.text: Upgrades Pippa. The first Event you play each turn that requires Agriculture gives you 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Every windowsill can become a small garden.

cards.name: Flint
cards.title: Trade Broker
cards.text: Upgrades Flint. Whenever you gain a non-Statue Capital City card, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Flint's percentage is small, and he takes it off everything.

cards.name: Winter Stores
cards.title: Capital City Building
cards.text: At the start of your turn, put 2 Supply by on one of your Characters.
cards.flavor: It was here before this Mayor, and it will be here after.

cards.name: Moss
cards.title: Toolsmith
cards.text: While Moss is upright, your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment by an opponent.
cards.flavor: A good tool, Moss says, is a favour you lend to tomorrow.

cards.name: Sorrel
cards.title: Harvest Caller
cards.text: Upgrades Sorrel. When Sorrel is recruited, if you control another Rabbit, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Sorrel calls the rows to work each morning, and Clover is always first in the field.

cards.name: Mabel
cards.title: Seed Vault Scientist
cards.text: Upgrades Mabel. The first Event you play each turn that requires Science lets you draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Every seed in the vault is labelled, dated, and asked politely to wait.

cards.name: Bristle
cards.title: Gate Hedgehog
cards.text: Hired from the Capital City; enters Busy. When Bristle becomes upright, a Character you control cannot be targeted by an opponent until your next turn.
cards.flavor: New in town, and already useful.

cards.name: Nib
cards.title: Canal Cartographer
cards.text: When Nib is recruited, your next Event needs one fewer Character.
cards.flavor: The shortest route usually passes a friend.

cards.name: Sorrel
cards.title: Row Boss
cards.text: Upgrades Sorrel. When Sorrel is recruited, if you control another Rabbit, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Sorrel runs the whole planting schedule from memory and a stub of chalk.

cards.name: Juniper
cards.title: Border Warden
cards.text: Upgrades Juniper. While Juniper is upright, your first bid each turn counts as 1 higher.
cards.flavor: Juniper traded the messenger's satchel for a hammer, and the town walls have never been sturdier.

cards.name: Vesper
cards.title: Moonlight Trader
cards.text: Upgrades Vesper. While Vesper is upright, your first bid each turn counts as 1 higher.
cards.flavor: Vesper deals after dark, when the prices are honest and the buyers are not.

cards.name: Late Frost
cards.text: On reveal: every shift in progress in both towns ends at once and produces nothing, then both Mayors draw 1 card. Goes to the City Dump.
cards.flavor: The blossoms were three days from ready, and now they are not.

cards.name: Pip
cards.title: Story Collector
cards.text: When Pip completes a shift, put 2 Supply by on Pip, then look at the top card of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: Pip trades in rumours, and pays in better ones.

cards.name: Hoot
cards.title: Night Porter
cards.text: Hired from the Capital City; enters Busy. Busy: one of your other Characters turns one step toward upright.
cards.flavor: New in town. Knocks on doors at four in the morning to say so.

cards.name: Copper
cards.title: Arcade Merchant
cards.text: Upgrades Copper. When Copper is recruited, your Characters advance an extra step at your next Ready.
cards.flavor: An honest measure makes a lasting friendship.

cards.name: Marmalade
cards.title: Neighborhood Baker
cards.text: Upgrades Marmalade. When Marmalade is recruited, your Characters advance an extra step at your next Ready.
cards.flavor: The first loaf is always for a neighbor.

cards.name: Rowan
cards.title: Records Clerk
cards.text: When you announce a purchase, look at the top 2 cards of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: Rowan writes everything down in her neat leather journal.

cards.name: Fern
cards.title: Field Scientist
cards.text: When Fern completes a shift, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Three notebooks: one for the weather, one for the birds, one for what the birds think of the weather.

cards.name: Kestrel
cards.title: City Fox
cards.text: Hired from the Capital City; enters Busy. Busy: add 2 Supply to an auction you are winning.
cards.flavor: New in town, and already useful.

cards.name: Nutmeg
cards.title: Night-Bloom Florist
cards.text: Upgrades Nutmeg. When Nutmeg completes a shift, put 1 Supply by on Nutmeg.
cards.flavor: Half the flowers only open at night, and half the customers only shop then. It works out.

cards.name: Flint
cards.title: Fair Warden
cards.text: Upgrades Flint. Busy: add 2 Supply to an auction you are winning.
cards.flavor: Flint keeps the fair honest, which mostly means keeping an eye on the Flint of five years ago.

cards.name: Rowan
cards.title: Locksmith
cards.text: Upgrades Rowan. When you announce a purchase, look at the top 2 cards of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: Rowan cuts a key for every door in town and keeps a spare for none of them.

cards.name: One Small Step
cards.text: Requires Comet and a Science Character. Gain 5 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: One small step for a Cat. One enormous mess in the Crafts hall.

cards.name: Lending Library
cards.title: Capital City Building
cards.text: At the start of your turn, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: It was here before this Mayor, and it will be here after.

cards.name: Thistle
cards.title: Almanac Keeper
cards.text: Busy: your town braces: the next shared shock passes it over.
cards.flavor: It says frost on Tuesday. It has said frost on Tuesday for eleven years, and one day it will be right.

cards.name: Velvet
cards.title: Neighborhood Registrar
cards.text: Upgrades Velvet. The first non-Statue Market card you gain each turn gives you 1 extra Supply.
cards.flavor: Every pawprint deserves a place in the town record.

cards.name: Rowan
cards.title: Circuit Judge
cards.text: A steady shift: 2 turns, 4 Supply.
cards.flavor: Rowan's journal became the town's law books; the handwriting never changed.

cards.name: Founder's Day
cards.text: On reveal: each Mayor may rehire one Character from their Unemployment for free; it enters upright, and at each Mayor's next Ready, their Characters do not advance. Goes to the City Dump.
cards.flavor: A day for old friends to come back to work, and for everyone else to take it slow.

cards.name: Poppy
cards.title: Ward Alderman
cards.text: When Poppy is recruited, if you control another Rabbit, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Poppy traded her mail route for a seat on the ward council, and never slowed down.

cards.name: Town Workshop
cards.title: Capital City Building
cards.text: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Supply. Each of your Events needs one fewer Character.
cards.flavor: It was here before this Mayor, and it will be here after.

cards.name: Thistle
cards.title: Grange Warden
cards.text: Upgrades Thistle. While Thistle is upright, your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment by an opponent.
cards.flavor: Nobody is left standing outside the grange in Thistle’s season.

cards.name: Oakley
cards.title: Boundary Surveyor
cards.text: Upgrades Oakley. While Oakley is upright, your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment by an opponent.
cards.flavor: Oakley paces out the town's edges every spring and reports what is coming down the road.

cards.name: Grand Repeal
cards.text: Send an opponent's Character to Unemployment, then gain 3 Supply. Goes Out of Play. (Cannot target a Character that has not yet been upright on its owner's turn.)
cards.flavor: The old charge is struck from the record, and the town breathes out.

cards.name: Brook
cards.title: Canal Pilot
cards.text: When Brook is recruited, another Character you control is upright at the start of your next turn.
cards.flavor: Brook knows which barges are coming before the lock keeper does, and Willow knows what they carry.

cards.name: Poppy
cards.title: Night Mail
cards.text: Upgrades Poppy. When Poppy becomes upright, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Second post. Third, if there is an Owl about.

cards.name: Willow
cards.title: Ferry Trader
cards.text: When Willow is recruited, another Character you control is upright at the start of your next turn.
cards.flavor: She is paid twice: once in coin, once in gossip from the far bank.

cards.name: Thimble
cards.title: Sailmaker
cards.text: Upgrades Thimble. Busy, once per game: Thimble readies itself.
cards.flavor: A quilt is a sail that has not yet met the wind, Thimble says, and prices accordingly.

cards.name: Mabel
cards.title: Seed Keeper
cards.text: When Mabel is recruited, your next Event needs one fewer Character.
cards.flavor: Mabel carefully saves seeds for next season's planting.

cards.name: Bramble
cards.title: Clockmaker
cards.text: Upgrades Bramble. When Bramble becomes upright, a Character you control cannot be targeted by an opponent until your next turn.
cards.flavor: Every clock in town is wrong by exactly the same amount, which is as good as right.

cards.name: Agricultural Show
cards.text: Requires two Agriculture Characters and a Agriculture Character. Gain 5 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: The pumpkin took first prize. The pumpkin took three carts to move.

cards.name: Thistle's Grange Supper
cards.text: Requires Thistle and an Agriculture Character. Gain 4 Supply, then you may rehire a Character from your Unemployment for 2 less Supply.
cards.flavor: There is always a chair at the long table for somebody who has been away.

cards.name: Copper
cards.title: Penny Counter
cards.text: Busy, once per game: Copper readies himself.
cards.flavor: Counts the till twice, sleeps in it once.

cards.name: Pebble
cards.title: Bridge Courier
cards.text: When Pebble is recruited, another Character you control is upright at the start of your next turn.
cards.flavor: Every bridge is an invitation to visit.

cards.name: The All-Night Café
cards.title: Capital City Building
cards.text: At the start of your turn, one of your Characters turns one step toward upright.
cards.flavor: Open when everything else is shut. Shut, in theory, on a day that has not yet been chosen.

cards.name: Patch
cards.title: Recycling Scout
cards.text: When Patch completes a shift, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Clever Patch finds hidden treasures in forgotten places.

cards.name: Thistle
cards.title: Field Surveyor
cards.text: Upgrades Thistle. While Thistle is upright, your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment by an opponent.
cards.flavor: Thistle measures the fields with the same long strides that once worked them.

cards.name: Thimble
cards.title: Spacesuit Seamstress
cards.text: Upgrades Thimble. Recruit: if you control Comet, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Fourteen pockets and a tail hole. The tail hole was the hard part.

cards.name: Acorn
cards.title: Coffee Cart
cards.text: Upgrades Acorn. When Acorn completes a shift, if you control an Owl, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Owls tip well and never sleep, which is the whole business plan.

cards.name: Comet
cards.title: Rocket Mechanic
cards.text: When Comet completes a shift, if you control a Science Character, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Comet has never met a machine she did not want to sit inside.

cards.name: Poppy
cards.title: Postmaster
cards.text: When Poppy is recruited, if you control another Rabbit, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Poppy hops from burrow to burrow with important letters.

cards.name: Hazel's Bargain
cards.text: Requires Hazel. Gain 3 Supply. Your next purchase announcement cannot be raised against.
cards.flavor: Hazel shakes on it before the other stallholders have finished counting.

cards.name: Mortar
cards.title: Grain Miller
cards.text: When Mortar is recruited, your town braces: the next shared shock passes it over.
cards.flavor: Before he fixed the watermill, Mortar fed it, one sack at a time.

cards.name: Moss
cards.title: Ploughwright
cards.text: When Moss is recruited, your town braces: the next shared shock passes it over.
cards.flavor: Moss mends ploughs in the spring and pride in the autumn, and charges less for the second.

cards.name: Tawny
cards.title: Night Watch
cards.text: When Tawny becomes upright, look at the top card of your deck; you may put it on the bottom.
cards.flavor: Nothing happens on the night watch. Tawny writes it all down anyway.

cards.name: Eureka!
cards.text: Requires two Science Characters. Gain 4 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: It was in the bath. It is always in the bath.

cards.name: Pippa
cards.title: Potting Helper
cards.text: When Pippa is recruited, your Characters advance an extra step at your next Ready.
cards.flavor: Every windowsill can become a small garden.

cards.name: Linnet
cards.title: Night Printer
cards.text: When Linnet completes a shift, if you control an Owl, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Tomorrow’s paper, printed tonight, read by the only ones awake.

cards.name: Beacon Hill
cards.text: Gain 3 Supply and ready two of your Characters.
cards.flavor: Light it and three boroughs answer before the hour is out.

cards.name: Linnet
cards.title: Bookbinder
cards.text: When Linnet is recruited, if you control another Rabbit, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: A repaired spine gives an old story a new beginning.

cards.name: Dill
cards.title: Herb Girl
cards.text: When Dill is recruited, your next Event needs one fewer Character.
cards.flavor: Dill sells bundles of mint and thyme from a basket twice her size.

cards.name: Counting House
cards.title: Capital City Building
cards.text: When you complete a shift, gain 2 extra Supply.
cards.flavor: It was here before this Mayor, and it will be here after.

cards.name: Rebuilt Barn
cards.text: Requires a Crafts Character, a Badger, and an Agriculture Character. Rehire any Character from your Unemployment for free, gain 2 Supply, and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: When the whole lane turns out, the barn goes up bigger than before.

cards.name: Thimble
cards.title: Thread Sorter
cards.text: When Thimble is recruited, your Characters advance an extra step at your next Ready.
cards.flavor: No scrap is too small to keep somebody warm.

cards.name: Vesper
cards.title: Night Courier
cards.text: When you announce a purchase, look at the top card of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: Vesper runs the lantern route between the burrow and the river, rain or shine.

cards.name: Hazel
cards.title: Night Market Vendor
cards.text: Upgrades Hazel. Recruit: draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: Everything half price after dark, on the grounds that you cannot quite see it.

cards.name: Marlow Reads the Bylaws
cards.text: Requires Marlow. Draw 2 cards. The next Event you play this turn requires one fewer Character.
cards.flavor: Subsection four, paragraph two: a committee of one is still a committee.

cards.name: Marmalade
cards.title: Night Baker
cards.text: A patient shift: 2 turns, then 2 Supply. When Marmalade completes a shift, if you control an Owl, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: The bread is ready at four in the morning, and so, unfortunately, is the baker.

cards.name: Boom Season
cards.text: On reveal: both Mayors gain 3 Supply and draw 1 card. Goes to the City Dump.
cards.flavor: Good weather, full carts, and everybody suddenly has an idea.

cards.name: Festival Parade
cards.text: Gain 3 Supply and draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: Drums down the high street and bunting on every rail.

cards.name: Founder's Grant
cards.text: Gain 6 Supply.
cards.flavor: The old founders left more behind than anyone expected.

cards.name: Tansy
cards.title: Observatory Keeper
cards.text: Recruit: choose another Character you control; it becomes upright at the start of your next turn.
cards.flavor: Lights the lamps at dusk, and puts out the stars at dawn.

cards.name: Promotion Board
cards.text: Gain 3 Supply, draw 1 card, and ready one of your Characters.
cards.flavor: Three references, one interview, and a new title painted on the door by teatime.

cards.name: Rowan
cards.title: Night Magistrate
cards.text: When Rowan starts a shift, look at the top card of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: Court sits at midnight. The verdict is usually “go to bed”.

cards.name: Thistle
cards.title: Field Hand
cards.text: While Thistle is upright, your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment by an opponent.
cards.flavor: Up before the lanterns, home after the moon.

cards.name: Marlow
cards.title: Bylaw Reader
cards.text: When Marlow completes a shift, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Young Marlow read the bylaws aloud to anyone who would listen. Only the Raccoons stayed.

cards.name: Apprentice Fair
cards.text: Recruit a Character costing 1 or less from your hand for free; it enters upright.
cards.flavor: Every stall is hiring, and every youngster has three offers by noon.

cards.name: Hard Winter
cards.text: On reveal: every shift in progress in both towns ends at once and produces nothing. Goes to the City Dump.
cards.flavor: Snow to the windowsills. Whatever was half-finished stays half-finished.

cards.name: A Wet Spring
cards.title: Word from the Capital
cards.text: Every shift in progress in both towns is abandoned.
cards.flavor: Word gets around.

cards.name: Quill
cards.title: Night Gardener
cards.text: A patient shift: 2 turns, then 2 Supply. Recruit: your next rehire costs 1 less Supply.
cards.flavor: Moonflowers only open after everybody sensible has gone in.

cards.name: Hedge Apothecary
cards.text: Requires a Hedgehog and a Mouse. Gain 2 Supply and draw 1 card, then you may rehire a Character from your Unemployment for 1 less Supply.
cards.flavor: One gathers, one grinds, and the whole borough sleeps better for it.

cards.name: Acorn
cards.title: Nut Runner
cards.text: When Acorn completes a shift, put 1 Supply by on Acorn.
cards.flavor: Half the nuts Acorn carries down to the ferry never quite reach the boat.

cards.name: Nutmeg
cards.title: Petal Sweeper
cards.text: When Nutmeg completes a shift, put 1 Supply by on Nutmeg.
cards.flavor: The florist's floor is the best place in town to learn which flowers sell.

cards.name: Double Thatch
cards.text: Requires a Hedgehog and a Badger. Gain 3 Supply and ready one of your Characters.
cards.flavor: Two roofs done before noon, and tea besides.

cards.name: Flint
cards.title: Auctioneer’s Boy
cards.text: Busy: you may pay 1 Supply to raise one of your open bids by 1.
cards.flavor: Cannot bid himself, but he can certainly shout numbers.

cards.name: Field Lecture
cards.text: Requires a Agriculture Character and a Lore Character. Draw 2 cards, gain 1 Supply, and look at the top two cards of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: The lecture is on root systems. The audience is here for the greenhouse tea.

cards.name: Guild Hall
cards.text: Recruit a Character costing 2 or less from your hand for free; it enters Busy.
cards.flavor: Apprentices sworn in beneath the old crossed hammers.

cards.name: Welcome Wagon
cards.text: Requires a Mouse. Recruit a cost-0 Character from your hand for free; it enters Busy.
cards.flavor: The town greets its newest friend with warm welcome.

cards.name: Study Hall
cards.text: Requires two Lore Characters. Limited 2: at the start of your turn, gain 1 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Quiet, please. Somebody is about to have an idea.

cards.name: Moon Landing Parade
cards.text: Gain 3 Supply, draw 1 card, and one of your Characters turns one step toward upright.
cards.flavor: Comet waved from the float for two hours and then asked, quietly, whether she could go up again.

cards.name: Fair Hearing
cards.text: Requires two Civics Characters. Rehire a Character from your Unemployment for free and draw 2 cards. Your opponent gains 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Justice finds its way through reasoned debate and mercy.

cards.name: Seed Swap
cards.text: Requires a Rabbit and a Mouse. Draw 3 cards, then discard 1 card, and gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Rabbits and Mice exchange precious seeds and stories.

cards.name: Hazel
cards.title: Barrow Girl
cards.text: When Hazel completes a shift, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Hazel pushed a barrow before she owned a stall, and Patch always knew which alley to push it down.

cards.name: Sage
cards.title: Telescope Polisher
cards.text: Recruit: look at the top two cards of your deck and put any of them on the bottom.
cards.flavor: Somebody has to keep the lens clean. Somebody has to be told, again, not to lick it.

cards.name: The Tax Assessors
cards.text: On reveal: both Mayors lose 4 Supply. Goes to the City Dump.
cards.flavor: They arrive with clipboards, and nobody remembers inviting them.

cards.name: Greenhouse Favor
cards.text: Requires a Mouse and a Agriculture Character. Gain 3 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Mice keep the glasshouse warm all winter long.

cards.name: Hoot and Holler
cards.text: Requires an Owl and a Cat. Gain 3 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: The only two animals awake at three in the morning, and neither of them will admit why.

cards.name: Guild Open Day
cards.text: Requires two Cats. Gain 3 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Small kindnesses make the whole borough feel like home.

cards.name: Bramble
cards.title: Tinker
cards.text: When Bramble is recruited, Bramble cannot be targeted by an opponent's effect until your next turn.
cards.flavor: Bramble can mend anything, given string, wax and an afternoon.

cards.name: Burr
cards.title: Barn Sweeper
cards.text: When Burr is recruited, Burr cannot be targeted by an opponent's effect until your next turn.
cards.flavor: Burr sweeps the barn twice as fast when Bramble is around to talk to.

cards.name: Paper Trail
cards.text: Requires a Raccoon and a Fox. Draw 2 cards. Your opponent puts a card from their hand on top of their deck.
cards.flavor: Raccoon and Fox uncover the truth through careful inquiry.

cards.name: Understudy Program
cards.text: Recruit a Character costing 1 or less from your hand for free; it enters Busy.
cards.flavor: Everyone starts somewhere, usually holding someone else's ladder.

cards.name: Russet
cards.title: Tea Boy
cards.text: When you announce a purchase, look at the top card of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: Russet learned the trade carrying trays for the cats of Whiskerwood, who tip in advice.

cards.name: The Auction House
cards.title: Capital City Building
cards.text: When you announce a purchase, add 1 Supply to your bid and look at the top three cards of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: It was here before this Mayor, and it will be here after.

cards.name: Auction Barker
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. Your next challenge at auction costs 2 less Supply.
cards.flavor: A booming voice that keeps the whole square listening.

cards.name: Science Fair
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. Your next recruit costs 2 less Supply.
cards.flavor: Volcanoes, mostly. One very confident potato.

cards.name: Spare Room
cards.text: Draw 3 cards.
cards.flavor: Kept made up and ready, for whoever the weather brings in.

cards.name: Statue of Kindness
cards.text: At the start of your turn, if you have no more Characters in Unemployment than your opponent, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Carved with open paws, it warms the whole square on cold mornings.
cards.burden: Burden: your opponent's rehires cost 1 less Supply.

cards.name: Community Oven
cards.text: Gain 4 Supply.
cards.flavor: Another welcoming corner of Whiskerwood.

cards.name: Festival Grant
cards.text: Gain 4 Supply.
cards.flavor: Gold for celebration, music, and merry gatherings.

cards.name: Statue of Patience
cards.text: Your Masters enter play with one fewer orientation delay (they enter Busy instead of at 180°).
cards.flavor: Moss grows on its shoulders, and it does not mind one bit.
cards.burden: Burden: your Apprentices enter Busy instead of upright.

cards.name: Harvest Fair
cards.text: Gain 5 Supply. Your opponent gains 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Ribbons for the marrows, and nobody goes home empty-pawed.

cards.name: Watermill
cards.text: Gain 2 Supply, and the next shift you complete produces 2 extra Supply.
cards.flavor: The wheel turns whether or not anyone is watching it.

cards.name: Inkwell's Late Shift
cards.text: Requires Inkwell. Draw 3 cards, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: The candle burns down. The stack of books does not.

cards.name: Thread Exchange
cards.text: Requires a Cat and a Rabbit. Gain 4 Supply.
cards.flavor: Small kindnesses make the whole borough feel like home.

cards.name: Toll Dispute
cards.text: On reveal: both Mayors lose 2 Supply, then each draws 1 card. Goes to the City Dump.
cards.flavor: A shouting match at the bridge, settled with paperwork and a shrug.

cards.name: Statue of Ingenuity
cards.text: Once per turn, an Event you play requires one fewer Character.
cards.flavor: Stone shaped to celebrate clever paws and minds.
cards.burden: Burden: your Events cost 1 more Supply.

cards.name: Early Riser
cards.text: Requires a Mouse. Limited 2: at the start of your turn, ready one of your Characters.
cards.flavor: First up, first fed, first out the door before the fog lifts.

cards.name: Pip's Reading Hour
cards.text: Requires Pip. Limited 2: at the start of your turn, draw 1 card and look at the top card of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: Pip reads to the whole square, and pauses at the good bits to see who is coming up the road.

cards.name: Lab Notes
cards.text: Requires a Science Character. Limited 2: at the start of your turn, look at the top two cards of your deck and put any of them on the bottom, then gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Day one: nothing. Day two: nothing, but written more neatly.

cards.name: Borrowed Basket
cards.text: Requires a Rabbit. Gain 2 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: A basket goes round the warren until it comes back empty and full at once.

cards.name: Spare Parts
cards.text: Requires a Crafts Character. Gain 2 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Nothing in the workshop ever really gets thrown away.

cards.name: Poppy's Post Route
cards.text: Requires Poppy. Gain 2 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Rain, snow or bidding war, the post gets through.

cards.name: Velvet's Petition
cards.text: Requires Velvet. Draw 1 card. Your next recruit costs 2 less Supply.
cards.flavor: Four hundred signatures, one of them a paw print, and the new hire starts on Monday.

cards.name: River Market
cards.text: Requires a Commerce Character. Gain 2 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Barges tie up two deep and the whole bank smells of hot pastry.

cards.name: Open Petition
cards.text: Requires Civics. Draw 1 card. Your next rehire costs 2 less Supply.
cards.flavor: Small kindnesses make the whole borough feel like home.

cards.name: Windowsill Garden
cards.text: Requires a Cat. Gain 2 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Small kindnesses make the whole borough feel like home.

cards.name: Barn Raising
cards.text: Requires two Crafts Characters. Gain 2 Supply and ready one of your Characters.
cards.flavor: The whole borough turns up; the roof is on by supper.

cards.name: Slack Water
cards.text: Requires an Otter and a Squirrel. Ready one of your Characters and gain 2 Supply.
cards.flavor: Between tides there's a lull just long enough to finish the job.

cards.name: Barn Meeting
cards.text: Requires a Badger and a Rabbit. Gain 2 Supply and ready one of your Characters.
cards.flavor: Half the lane shows up to fix the fence and stays for the vote.

cards.name: Statue of Curiosity
cards.text: On gain: draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: Its stone eyes follow whoever wonders loudest what lies beyond the hill.
cards.burden: Burden: at the end of your turn, if you hold more than 6 cards, discard 1.

cards.name: Masters' Lodge
cards.text: Ready one of your Masters and draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: Behind the oak door, the old hands argue about who taught whom.

cards.name: Statue of Generosity
cards.text: On gain: give your opponent 1 Supply and draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: A statue with open arms, sharing freely with all.
cards.burden: Burden: whenever you gain a Statue, including this one, your opponent gains 2 Supply.

cards.name: Clover's Seed Drive
cards.text: Requires Clover. Gain 2 Supply, and another Agriculture Character you control becomes upright at the start of your next turn.
cards.flavor: Every packet Clover hands out comes back as a basket in the autumn.

cards.name: Cat Nap
cards.text: Requires a Cat. Choose another Character you control; it becomes upright at the start of your next turn. Then gain 2 Supply.
cards.flavor: Twenty minutes in a sunbeam and the whole town looks manageable.

cards.name: A Helping Hand
cards.title: Word from the Capital
cards.text: The Mayor with fewer Statues gains 4 Supply and draws a card.
cards.flavor: Word gets around.

cards.name: Guild Retraining
cards.text: Requires two Crafts Characters. Ready two of your Characters.
cards.flavor: A new trade is only an old trade with different tools, the guild says, and hands them over.

cards.name: Tea Trade Route
cards.text: Requires a Fox and a Cat. Gain 3 Supply and look at the top two cards of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: The foxes bring the leaves; the cats know exactly who will pay for them.

cards.name: Old Boundary Stone
cards.text: Send an opponent's Character with cost 3 or less to Unemployment. Goes Out of Play. (Cannot target a Character that has not yet been upright on its owner's turn.)
cards.flavor: Older than the charter, and far less willing to argue.

cards.name: Sage’s Star Party
cards.text: Requires Sage and a Science Character. Draw 2 cards, then look at the top two cards of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: Bring a blanket. Bring a flask. Do not, under any circumstances, bring a lantern.

cards.name: Statue of Joy
cards.text: On gain: ready up to two of your Apprentices.
cards.flavor: Carved in laughter, capturing happiness forever.
cards.burden: Burden: at the start of your turn, give 1 Supply to your opponent.

cards.name: A Slow Season
cards.text: Each Mayor sends one Character of their choice to Unemployment.
cards.flavor: Trade is thin, the days are long, and there is simply less to do than there are paws to do it.

cards.name: The Damp
cards.text: Each Mayor sends one Character costing 3 or less to Unemployment.
cards.flavor: It got into the workshops, the ledgers and the bread. The senior staff have retreated upstairs.

cards.name: Ledger Audit
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. Your opponent puts a card from their hand on top of their deck.
cards.flavor: Column by column, until the awkward entry surfaces.

cards.name: Undercut
cards.text: Requires a Commerce Character and a Civics Character. Discard a card, then send one opposing Character with cost 2 or less to Unemployment.
cards.flavor: A quiet word in the right office, and the paperwork does the rest.

cards.name: Kettle and Cup
cards.text: Gain 4 Supply.
cards.flavor: Whatever the trouble, it waits until the tea is poured.

cards.name: Nib
cards.title: Ink Mixer
cards.text: When Nib is recruited, your next Event needs one fewer Character.
cards.flavor: Nib grinds the ink; the cats bring the stories that need writing down.

cards.name: A Shared Book
cards.text: Requires a Cat and a Mouse. Draw 3 cards, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: Small kindnesses make the whole borough feel like home.

cards.name: River Ferry
cards.text: Gain 2 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Tuppence a crossing, and the news is thrown in free.

cards.name: Vesper’s Forecast
cards.text: Requires Vesper. Look at the top three cards of the Market Deck, then gain 2 Supply.
cards.flavor: Fine, then wet, then a Statue in the afternoon.

cards.name: Toolbox Trade
cards.text: Requires a Crafts Character and a Badger. Rehire a Character with cost 2 or less from your Unemployment for free, then draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Badger vouches, the Crafts guild waives the fee.

cards.name: Statue of Courage
cards.text: Your next raise in a Capital City auction costs 1 less Supply to pay.
cards.flavor: A monument to those who face their fears bravely.
cards.burden: Burden: your opponent's first bid each turn is worth 1 more.

cards.name: Second Chances
cards.text: Rehire up to two Characters, each for 2 less Supply.
cards.flavor: The Registrar keeps a separate book for people who only needed a fortnight off.

cards.name: Swarm of Gnats
cards.text: On reveal: each Mayor draws 1 card, then discards down to 4 cards in hand. Goes to the City Dump.
cards.flavor: A cloud rises off the marsh and everyone starts flapping their paperwork.

cards.name: Clear Skies
cards.text: On reveal: both Mayors draw 2 cards. Goes to the City Dump.
cards.flavor: Not a cloud for a week, and every chore feels lighter for it.

cards.name: Rent Hike
cards.text: On reveal: both Mayors lose 3 Supply. Goes to the City Dump.
cards.flavor: A new figure on the noticeboard, written in a very confident hand.

cards.name: A Good Harvest
cards.title: Word from the Capital
cards.text: Both Mayors gain 3 Supply.
cards.flavor: Word gets around.

cards.name: A Lean Month
cards.title: Word from the Capital
cards.text: Both Mayors lose 3 Supply.
cards.flavor: Word gets around.

cards.name: News Travels Fast
cards.title: Word from the Capital
cards.text: Both Mayors draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: Word gets around.

cards.name: Statue of Community
cards.text: If you control Characters of at least three species, the first shift you complete each turn produces 1 extra Supply.
cards.flavor: Standing strong together, a monument to unity.
cards.burden: Burden: choosing Supply in your Resources phase gives you 1 less.

cards.name: Blooming Confidence
cards.text: Requires two Rabbits. Ready one of your Characters and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: One brave blossom opens, and the whole hedgerow follows.

cards.name: Tidewater Ledger
cards.text: Requires a Fox and a Commerce Character. Gain 3 Supply and look at the top card of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: Fox keeps the numbers; Otter keeps the route; between them nothing is lost.

cards.name: Community Garden
cards.text: Requires an Agriculture Character. Gain 3 Supply.
cards.flavor: Friends gather to plant seeds and share their harvest.

cards.name: Bean’s Coffee Break
cards.text: Requires Bean. Two of your other Characters each turn one step toward upright.
cards.flavor: Fifteen minutes. Everybody back on their feet. Possibly slightly vibrating.

cards.name: Mortar’s Boiler Test
cards.text: Requires Mortar. Gain 2 Supply. Your town braces: the next shared shock passes it over.
cards.flavor: Everybody behind the wall, please. No, further.

cards.name: Rumor Control
cards.text: Requires a Fox. Draw 1 card. Until your next turn, opponent effects cannot make you discard or lose Supply.
cards.flavor: Whispers fade fast when a clever Fox sets the record straight.

cards.name: Tidy Books
cards.text: Requires a Commerce Character. Gain 3 Supply.
cards.flavor: Every column adds up, and the surplus goes straight to the till.

cards.name: Acorn Cache
cards.text: Requires a Squirrel. Gain 2 Supply and your next recruit costs 1 less.
cards.flavor: Buried last autumn, remembered — mostly — this spring.

cards.name: Low Tide Cache
cards.text: Requires a Squirrel. Gain 3 Supply.
cards.flavor: Buried below the waterline, safe till the tide turns.

cards.name: Fair Measure
cards.text: Requires Commerce. Gain 2 Supply. Your next recruit costs 1 less Supply.
cards.flavor: Small kindnesses make the whole borough feel like home.

cards.name: Fresh Batch
cards.text: Requires Agriculture. Gain 3 Supply.
cards.flavor: Small kindnesses make the whole borough feel like home.

cards.name: Tea and Tales
cards.text: Requires a Cat. Draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: Small kindnesses make the whole borough feel like home.

cards.name: Bookbinders' Arcade
cards.text: Draw 3 cards, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: Another welcoming corner of Whiskerwood.

cards.name: Journeyman's Road
cards.text: Ready one of your Journeymen, then gain 2 Supply.
cards.flavor: The road out of town is also, if you keep walking, the road back in.

cards.name: Library Annex
cards.text: Draw 3 cards, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: A room full of stories, wisdom, and forgotten lore.

cards.name: Mended Fences
cards.text: Requires a Badger. Rehire a Character from your Unemployment for 1 less Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: A quiet apology, a new rail, and the gate swings true again.

cards.name: Far Bank Story
cards.text: Requires an Otter, a Fox, and a Lore Character. Limited 2: at the start of your turn, draw 1 card and look at the top card of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: Fox tells it slant, Otter tells it true, and somehow it's the same story.

cards.name: Town Census
cards.text: Requires a Civics Character. Limited 2: at the start of your turn, if you control Characters of at least three species, gain 2 Supply.
cards.flavor: The census taker counts ears, tails and whiskers, and the town treasury counts the rest.

cards.name: Arcade Fair
cards.text: Requires Commerce. Limited 2: the first non-Statue Market card you gain each turn gives you 2 extra Supply.
cards.flavor: A little time together goes a long way.

cards.name: Hiring Season
cards.text: Each Mayor may rehire one Character free of charge.
cards.flavor: Every noticeboard in both towns is suddenly three sheets deep.

cards.name: Open Hiring Fair
cards.text: On reveal: each Mayor may rehire one Character from their Unemployment for free; it enters upright. Goes to the City Dump.
cards.flavor: Trestle tables on the green, and a queue that moves surprisingly fast.

cards.name: Night Shift
cards.text: Requires an Owl. One of your Characters turns one step toward upright, then draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: The town sleeps. The Owls do not. Somebody has to mind the shop, and somebody else has to be woken to help.

cards.name: Open Doors
cards.title: Word from the Capital
cards.text: Both Mayors rehire one Character from Unemployment for free.
cards.flavor: Word gets around.

cards.name: The Late Shift
cards.text: Two of your Characters each turn one step toward upright, then gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Time and a half, and all the bread the Night Baker cannot sell.

cards.name: Everybody Looks Up
cards.text: Requires a Science Character. Your opponent puts a card from their hand on top of their deck, then you draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: “What is that?” “A balloon.” “Whose?” “Comet’s.” “Is Comet in it?” “...”

cards.name: Bottomless Satchel
cards.text: Requires an Otter, a Squirrel, and a Lore Character. Look at the top three cards of your deck and put them back in any order, then draw 1 card and gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Somewhere in that satchel is exactly what you need — you just have to find it first.

cards.name: Courier Shortcut
cards.text: Requires Civics. Choose a Character you control to become upright at the start of your next turn, then draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Small kindnesses make the whole borough feel like home.

cards.name: Census Office
cards.text: Gain 1 Supply and draw 1 card. Your next rehire costs 1 less Supply.
cards.flavor: Name, trade, previous trade, trade before that. Take a seat.

cards.name: Lantern Terrace
cards.text: Gain 2 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Another welcoming corner of Whiskerwood.

cards.name: Returning Champion
cards.text: Ready two of your Characters.
cards.flavor: Back from a hard season, and straight back to work.

cards.name: Statue of Harmony
cards.text: Whenever a purchase you are part of resolves with a tied bid, ready one of your Characters at the start of your next turn.
cards.flavor: A peaceful figure, bringing all voices into accord.
cards.burden: Burden: every pledge you make in an auction must be one step more expensive than the ladder asks.

cards.name: Inkwell’s Star Chart
cards.text: Requires Inkwell. Look at the top three cards of your deck and put any of them on the bottom, then draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Inkwell charts the sky by which stars he can see from the good chair.

cards.name: Stargazing
cards.text: Requires a Lore Character. Draw 1 card, then look at the top three cards of your deck and put any of them on the bottom.
cards.flavor: That one is the Plough. That one is the Kettle. That one is the Plough again from a different angle.

cards.name: Night School
cards.text: Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card, and gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: The lamps stay lit until the last question is answered.

cards.name: Bounty Notice
cards.text: You may discard a card to send an opponent's Character with cost 2 or less to Unemployment. (Cannot target a Character that has not yet been upright on its owner's turn.)
cards.flavor: Posted at the crossroads, it gets results whether or not it gets read.

cards.name: Retraining Hall
cards.text: Ready one of your Characters and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Walk in a farmer, walk out a clerk. The hat shop is next door.

cards.name: Scrap Yard
cards.text: You may discard a card to send an opponent's Character with cost 2 or less to Unemployment. (Cannot target a Character that has not yet been upright on its owner's turn.)
cards.flavor: A place of salvage where nothing goes to waste.

cards.name: Glut of Squash
cards.text: Requires two Agriculture Characters. Gain 4 Supply, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: The garden gave more than anyone asked for, again.

cards.name: Workshop Swap
cards.text: Requires a Crafts Character and a Hedgehog. Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card. Your next recruit costs 1 less.
cards.flavor: Everyone leaves with someone else’s half-finished project.

cards.name: Comet’s Countdown
cards.text: Requires Comet. Limited 3: at the start of your turn, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Three. Two. One. (Comet is still doing up her boots.)

cards.name: Market Day
cards.text: Requires a Commerce Character. Limited 2: your first purchase announcement each turn draws 1 card.
cards.flavor: Everyone gathers to trade, talk, and make their bids.

cards.name: Rune Reading
cards.text: Requires a Lore Character and an Otter. Draw 3 cards, then discard 2 cards, and look at the top card of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: The stones say: fortune, and also, mind the third step.

cards.name: Reading Lanterns
cards.text: Requires Lore. Limited 2: at the start of your turn, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: A little time together goes a long way.

cards.name: Canal Map Room
cards.text: Draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: Another welcoming corner of Whiskerwood.

cards.name: Hat Maker's Shop
cards.text: Gain 2 Supply. Your next recruit costs 1 less Supply.
cards.flavor: A new hat, the milliner says, is the first day of a new job.

cards.name: Orchard Share
cards.text: Gain 3 Supply.
cards.flavor: Every household gets a crate when the trees are this generous.

cards.name: Supply Depot
cards.text: Gain 3 Supply.
cards.flavor: Carefully stored goods for the town's daily needs.

cards.name: Charter Repairs
cards.text: Requires a Civics Character and a Crafts Character. Rehire a Character costing 3 or less from your Unemployment for free, and gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: The charter gets amended, the roof gets patched, and an old friend gets rehired to help.

cards.name: Double Shift Horn
cards.text: The next shift you complete produces 3 extra Supply.
cards.flavor: One long blast, and the whole crew turns back to the tools.

cards.name: Bridge Out
cards.text: On reveal: at each Mayor's next Ready, their Characters do not advance. Goes to the City Dump.
cards.flavor: Two planks and a rope, and the whole borough waits.

cards.name: Solar Eclipse
cards.text: At each Mayor’s next Ready, their Characters do not advance: everybody has stopped to look up.
