cards.flavor: Two minutes of darkness at noon, and every animal in both boroughs standing in the street with a bit of smoked glass.

cards.name: Coffee Round
cards.text: One of your Characters turns one step toward upright, then draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Bean does the rounds with a tray. Nobody has ever said no.

cards.name: Whiskerwood Guildhall
cards.text: Draw 1 card. Your next recruit costs 2 less Supply.
cards.flavor: Another welcoming corner of Whiskerwood.

cards.name: Tawny’s Night Class
cards.text: Requires Tawny. Limited 2: at the start of your turn, one of your Characters turns one step toward upright.
cards.flavor: Tonight: fractions, the constellations, and why you should have gone to bed.

cards.name: Guild Charter
cards.text: Draw 1 card. Your next recruit costs 1 less Supply.
cards.flavor: Sealed in wax and read aloud twice a year, whether anyone is listening or not.

cards.name: Penny Jar
cards.text: Gain 1 Supply and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: A few coppers rattling behind the counter, saved for exactly this.

cards.name: Meteor Shower
cards.text: Both Mayors draw 1 card and gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Make a wish. Make a sensible one; the last Mayor wished for more paperwork and got it.

cards.name: Second Telling
cards.text: Requires two Lore Characters. Limited 2: at the start of your turn, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: The story gets retold enough times that everyone knows their part.

cards.name: Audit of the Walls
cards.text: Requires a Raccoon and a Badger. Gain 2 Supply. Until your next turn, your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment.
cards.flavor: The Raccoon checks the ledger, the Badger checks the mortar, and nobody gets through either.

cards.name: High Bidder's Ring
cards.text: Raise your own bid on an auction you are winning by 4 Supply, then draw 2 cards. Goes Out of Play.
cards.flavor: Worn only by those who intend to leave the auction with the prize.

cards.name: Full Moon
cards.text: The Mayor with fewer Statues readies a Character and gains 2 Supply.
cards.flavor: The moon shines on the town that needs it. The Owls have been saying so for years.

cards.name: Old Friends' Reunion
cards.text: Rehire a Character from your Unemployment for free; it enters upright. Then gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Nobody remembers who left, only who came back.

cards.name: Shared Toolshed
cards.text: The next shift you complete produces 1 extra Supply, and you draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Sign the slate, take the saw, bring it back sharp.

cards.name: Telescope Hire
cards.text: Look at the top three cards of the Market Deck, then draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: A penny a look. Two pennies if you want to see something in particular.

cards.name: Patchwork Gift
cards.text: Requires Crafts. You may rehire a Character for 1 less Supply, then gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Small kindnesses make the whole borough feel like home.

cards.name: Open Ledger
cards.text: Requires a Commerce Character. Gain 2 Supply and look at the top card of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: Every coin counted twice, every promise written down once.

cards.name: Glasshouse Walk
cards.text: You may ready one of your Characters, then gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Another welcoming corner of Whiskerwood.

cards.name: Night Market
cards.text: Gain 2 Supply, then look at the top two cards of your deck and put any of them on the bottom.
cards.flavor: Lanterns, stalls, and the pleasant feeling that everything is slightly cheaper than it should be.

cards.name: Paperwork Backlog
cards.text: On reveal: both Mayors discard down to 3 cards in hand. Goes to the City Dump.
cards.flavor: Every form needs another form, and the pile has begun to lean.

cards.name: Acorn's Bidding War
cards.text: Requires Acorn and a Commerce Character. Gain 2 Supply, then you may pay 2 Supply to raise one of your open bids by 2.
cards.flavor: Acorn bids like a squirrel buries nuts: often, and with total confidence.

cards.name: Hedgerow Guard
cards.text: Requires a Hedgehog. Until your next turn, your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment and opponent effects cannot make you discard or lose Supply.
cards.flavor: Spines out, lanterns lit, and the hedgerow keeps its own.

cards.name: Weather Balloon
cards.text: Look at the top two cards of the Market Deck and gain 2 Supply.
cards.flavor: It went up with a thermometer and came down with a very cross pigeon.

cards.name: Open Positions
cards.text: Rehire one Character, then draw a card.
cards.flavor: Somebody has finally got round to reading the pile of applications.

cards.name: Story Circle
cards.text: Put an Event from your Town Dump on the bottom of your deck and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Told once more, a little truer, and back into the pile it goes.

cards.name: Owl Post
cards.text: Draw 1 card and gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Delivered overnight, by somebody who was up anyway.

cards.name: Poacher's Pardon
cards.text: Send an opponent's Character to Unemployment, then discard 2 cards. (Cannot target a Character that has not yet been upright on its owner's turn.)
cards.flavor: The cage door swings open, but somebody still has to answer for it.

cards.name: Moss's Rehiring Day
cards.text: Requires Moss. Rehire a Character from your Unemployment for free; it enters upright.
cards.flavor: Moss keeps every old apprentice's apron on a hook, just in case.

cards.name: Blossom Week
cards.text: Requires Agriculture. Limited 2: the first Event you play each turn that requires Agriculture lets you draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: A little time together goes a long way.

cards.name: Seed Exchange
cards.text: Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: Two handfuls in, one handful out, and everyone plants something new.

cards.name: Public Gardens
cards.text: The next shift you complete produces 2 extra Supply.
cards.flavor: Flourishing beds of green that feed and gladden.

cards.name: Furrow Line
cards.text: Requires an Agriculture Character. Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: Straight rows make for easy weeding and easier gossip.

cards.name: Dew Meadow
cards.text: Gain 2 Supply.
cards.flavor: The grass is always sweetest just after sunrise.

cards.name: Towpath
cards.text: Gain 2 Supply.
cards.flavor: A good path, a patient rope, and the barge comes home.

cards.name: Public Notice
cards.text: Requires a Civics Character. Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: Posted at the crossroads before the ink is even dry.

cards.name: Dog-Eared Page
cards.text: Requires a Lore Character. Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: Someone always folds the corner instead of using a bookmark.

cards.name: Midnight Index
cards.text: Requires Lore. Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: Small kindnesses make the whole borough feel like home.

cards.name: Rocket Fuel
cards.text: At your next Ready, your Characters advance one extra orientation step. Gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Do not store near the coffee. Do not confuse with the coffee. It has happened.

cards.name: Patch’s Contraption
cards.text: Requires Patch. Take a Market card from the City Dump and gain it.
cards.flavor: It has a handle, a funnel, three wheels and a whistle. Nobody knows what it does. It works beautifully.

cards.name: Market Glut
cards.text: On reveal: both Mayors gain 2 Supply. Goes to the City Dump.
cards.flavor: Too many pumpkins, too little room in the cellar, and everyone benefits.

cards.name: Town Bell
cards.text: Ready one of your Apprentices.
cards.flavor: It rings to gather townsfolk for news and celebration.

cards.name: Double Espresso
cards.text: Requires a Commerce Character. Ready one of your Characters.
cards.flavor: Not so much a drink as an instruction.

cards.name: Tea House Arcade
cards.text: Gain 3 Supply. Your opponent gains 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Another welcoming corner of Whiskerwood.

cards.name: Borrowed Ladder
cards.text: Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
cards.flavor: It goes from roof to roof and nobody quite remembers whose it was.

cards.name: Tool Lending Day
cards.text: Requires a Crafts Character. Ready one of your Characters.
cards.flavor: Borrow the plane, return the plane, and stay for tea.

cards.name: Ferry Charter
cards.text: Requires an Otter. Ready one of your Characters; a working Character finishes its shift.
cards.flavor: Signed, stamped, and away before the ink is dry.

cards.name: Garden Helpers
cards.text: Requires Agriculture. You may ready one of your Characters.
cards.flavor: Small kindnesses make the whole borough feel like home.

cards.name: Neighborhood Watch
cards.text: Requires a Civics Character. Rehire a Character from your Unemployment for 2 less Supply.
cards.flavor: Neighbors look after one another with gentle vigilance.

cards.name: Root Cellar
cards.text: Requires an Agriculture Character. Rehire a Character from your Unemployment for 2 less Supply.
cards.flavor: Stored deep and kept cool, some friendships keep like potatoes.

cards.name: Common Pasture
cards.text: Rehire a Character costing 2 or less from your Unemployment for free; it enters upright.
cards.flavor: There is always room on the common for one more pair of paws.

cards.name: Patient Harvest
cards.text: Requires a Agriculture Character. Limited 2: the first shift you complete each turn produces 1 extra Supply.
cards.flavor: Time passes slowly; the garden rewards those who wait.

cards.name: Winter Stores
cards.text: Requires an Agriculture Character. Limited 2: at the start of your turn, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Root cellars full, shelves labelled, and nobody hungry in the thaw.

cards.name: Rooftop Supper
cards.text: Requires a Cat. Limited 2: the first shift you complete each turn gives you 1 extra Supply.
cards.flavor: A little time together goes a long way.

cards.name: Sewing Circle
cards.text: Requires Crafts. Limited 2: at the start of your turn, gain 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: A little time together goes a long way.

cards.name: Welcome Committee
cards.text: Requires Civics. Limited 2: the first shift you start each turn gives you 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: A little time together goes a long way.

cards.name: Fairweight Scales
cards.text: Your next recruit and your next rehire each cost 1 less Supply.
cards.flavor: Another welcoming corner of Whiskerwood.

cards.name: Lucky Horseshoe
cards.text: The next raise against an auction you are winning is cancelled; your bid stays open.
cards.flavor: Nailed above the door, points up, for holding onto what's yours.

cards.name: Apprentice Bell
cards.text: Ready one of your Apprentices.
cards.flavor: One clang and the youngest paws come running back to work.

cards.name: Tailors' Cooperative
cards.text: You may rehire a Character for 2 less Supply.
cards.flavor: Another welcoming corner of Whiskerwood.

cards.name: Almshouse
cards.text: Rehire a Character costing 2 or less from your Unemployment for free; it enters upright.
cards.flavor: The door is never locked and the soup is never quite finished.

cards.name: Community Kitchen
cards.text: Rehire a cost-1 Character from your Unemployment for free; it enters upright.
cards.flavor: A heart of warmth where friends share meals daily.

cards.name: Quiet Mediation
cards.text: The next raise against an auction you are winning is cancelled; your bid stays open.
cards.flavor: A space for calm voices to settle hot disputes.

cards.name: Mayor's Seal
cards.text: Your next purchase announcement cannot be raised against.
cards.flavor: The mayor's official mark of protection and authority.

cards.name: A Quiet Word
cards.text: Your next purchase announcement cannot be raised against.
cards.flavor: Said low, over the fence, and somehow everyone gets the message.

cards.name: Ironwood Palisade
cards.text: Prevent up to 5 Supply you would lose to opponent effects, and your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment until your next turn.
cards.flavor: Raised in a single storm-lit night, and still standing when the sun came up.

cards.name: Pigeon Post
cards.text: Draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: A tap at the window, and the news arrives before breakfast.

cards.name: Appeal Board
cards.text: Your next rehire costs 2 less Supply.
cards.flavor: Second chances and reconsideration for those wronged.

cards.name: Hushed Agreement
cards.text: Requires a Commerce Character and a Lore Character. Limited 2: your challenge bids win ties.
cards.flavor: No shouting, no banners — just two paws shaken behind the archive.

cards.name: Second Wind
cards.text: Requires a Hedgehog. Limited 2: at the start of your turn, your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment until your next turn.
cards.flavor: Twice over, the hedgerow closes ranks.

cards.name: Civic Rally
cards.text: Requires a Civics Character. Limited 2: your first bid each turn counts as 1 higher.
cards.flavor: The town gathers to speak its mind and make decisions.

cards.name: Current Reading
cards.text: Requires an Otter. Limited 2: at the start of your turn, look at the top two cards of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: The river tells you what's coming, if you know how to read it.

cards.name: Courier Network
cards.text: Look at the top five cards of your deck and put them back in any order.
cards.flavor: Swift paws connect the far reaches of the realm.

cards.name: Mason's Yard
cards.text: Ready one of your Characters.
cards.flavor: Dust, chisels, and the patient shaping of a town.

cards.name: Star Chart
cards.text: Look at the top three cards of your deck and put any of them on the bottom.
cards.flavor: Not to scale. Nothing about the sky is to scale.

cards.name: Emergency Reserve
cards.text: Prevent up to 3 Supply you would lose to opponent effects. Goes Out of Play.
cards.flavor: Saved supplies for when hardship comes unexpectedly.

cards.name: Told by Lamplight
cards.text: Requires a Lore Character. Limited 2: at the start of your turn, look at the top two cards of your deck and put them back in any order.
cards.flavor: The story goes long, and everyone stays for the end of it.

cards.name: East Road Stall
cards.text: Gain 2 Supply. Your opponent gains 1 Supply.
cards.flavor: Trade is trade, even when it's your rival buying the last apple.

cards.name: The Long Road
cards.title: Word from the Capital
cards.text: The Mayor with fewer Statues readies a Character.
cards.flavor: Word gets around.

cards.name: Signal Kite
cards.text: Look at the top four cards of your deck and put them back in any order.
cards.flavor: Flown from the ridge, it tells the whole valley what's coming.

cards.name: Toll Gate
cards.text: Your opponent puts a card from their hand on top of their deck.
cards.flavor: One coin and a wave through, unless the gatekeeper has questions.

cards.name: Blossom Court
cards.text: At the start of your next turn, advance all your Characters one extra orientation step.
cards.flavor: Another welcoming corner of Whiskerwood.

cards.name: Lamplighter's Round
cards.text: Look at the top three cards of your deck and put them back in any order.
cards.flavor: Every lamp lit in order, and the order is never an accident.

cards.name: Millpond Dock
cards.text: The next shift you complete produces 1 extra Supply.
cards.flavor: Where the barges wait their turn and the water does the rest.

cards.name: Second Opinion
cards.text: Look at the top three cards of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: Ask two badgers and you'll get three answers, but at least you'll have looked.

cards.name: Town Archives
cards.text: Return an Event from your Town Dump to your hand. Goes Out of Play.
cards.flavor: Ancient records holding the town's true history.

cards.name: Town Clock
cards.text: At the start of your next turn, advance all your Characters one extra orientation step.
cards.flavor: Its bells hurry the whole town along, one extra tick at a time.

cards.name: Cobbler's Favor
cards.text: Your next recruit costs 1 less Supply.
cards.flavor: New soles for an old debt, and the accounts are square again.

cards.name: Town Charter
cards.text: The first Character you recruit before your next turn costs 1 less.
cards.flavor: The founding promise that binds this town together.

cards.name: Whittler's Bench
cards.text: Your next challenge at auction costs 1 less Supply.
cards.flavor: A quiet corner for shaping small, useful things.

cards.name: Almanac Page
cards.text: Put an Event from your Town Dump on the bottom of your deck.
cards.flavor: Torn loose and pinned above the hearth, for reading again next winter.

cards.name: Rehiring Notice
cards.text: Your next rehire costs 1 less Supply.
cards.flavor: Posted fresh on the board, right over last season's regrets.

cards.name: Stocktaking
cards.title: Word from the Capital
cards.text: Both Mayors discard down to 5 cards.
cards.flavor: Word gets around.

cards.name: Sly Appraisal
cards.text: Requires a Raccoon. Limited 2: at the start of your turn, look at the top card of the Market Deck.
cards.flavor: A Raccoon always checks what's coming before anyone else does.

cards.name: Hedgerow Shortcut
cards.text: Look at the top two cards of your deck and put them back in any order.
cards.flavor: Everyone in town knows the gap in the hedge, but nobody tells the mayor.

cards.name: Night Watch
cards.text: Until your next turn, your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment.
cards.flavor: Two lanterns, one route, and a very determined badger.

cards.name: Night Patrol
cards.text: Until your next turn, your Characters cannot be sent to Unemployment.
cards.flavor: Lanterns bobbing along the wall until the sky goes grey.

cards.name: Silent Partner
cards.text: Requires a Raccoon and a Commerce Character. Raise your bid on an auction you are currently winning by 2 Supply.
cards.flavor: A friendly nod across the table, and the price climbs quietly.

cards.name: Comet Watch
cards.title: Capital City Ordinance
cards.text: While this is displayed, no Statue may be bought: the whole square is looking up. Either Mayor may put an upright Character to work steadying the telescopes; when two have been put to work, between them or by one Mayor alone, the comet passes and this leaves the Capital City.
cards.flavor: It comes once every seventy years, the Royal Astronomer says. She has been saying so for eleven days.

cards.name: Building Boom
cards.title: Capital City Ordinance
cards.text: While this is displayed, Buildings cost 3 less.
cards.flavor: Posted on the board by the market steps.

cards.name: Founders' Discount
cards.title: Capital City Ordinance
cards.text: While this is displayed, Statues cost 3 less.
cards.flavor: Posted on the board by the market steps.

cards.name: Going Once
cards.title: Capital City Ordinance
cards.text: While this is displayed, no auction may be raised: every announcement stands.
cards.flavor: Posted on the board by the market steps.

cards.name: High Standards
cards.title: Capital City Ordinance
cards.text: While this is displayed, every pledge in an auction must be one step more expensive than usual.
cards.flavor: Posted on the board by the market steps.

cards.name: Monument Tax
cards.title: Capital City Ordinance
cards.text: While this is displayed, Statues cost 4 more.
cards.flavor: Posted on the board by the market steps.

cards.name: Open Bidding
cards.title: Capital City Ordinance
cards.text: While this is displayed, every Mayor may open an auction with any Character, whatever it costs.
cards.flavor: Posted on the board by the market steps.

cards.name: Works in the Square
cards.text: While this is displayed, no Statue may be bought. Either Mayor may put an upright Character to work clearing the square; when two have been put to work, between them or by one Mayor alone, the works finish and this leaves the Capital City.
cards.flavor: Half the square is scaffolding and the other half is a very deep hole. The Statue yard is, regrettably, on the far side of the hole.

marketDeck.$comment: Legacy single-deck field, kept so older callers keep working: it mirrors marketDecks[0]. Prefer marketDecks and pass `market` to createGame.
marketDeck.name: First Boroughs
marketDeck.blurb: The classic market: a broad mix of growth, card flow and pointed disruption, and no shared shocks.

marketDecks.name: First Boroughs
marketDecks.blurb: The classic market: a broad mix of growth, card flow and pointed disruption. Its weather is mild — three of its on-reveal cards are shocks.

marketDecks.name: Boom Town
marketDecks.blurb: Prosperity and momentum. Supply flows freely, direct disruption is rare, and shared shocks are mostly good news.

marketDecks.name: Hard Times
marketDecks.blurb: A harsh market. Recessions, hard winters and backlogs strike both towns alike, and the cards that survive them are worth fighting over.

marketDecks.name: Founders' Fair
marketDecks.blurb: The expansion market: auction tools, understudies and second chances, with a fair-weather shock or two and nothing that empties a town.

marketDecks.name: Whiskerwood Fair
marketDecks.blurb: A welcoming artisan district: ten new shops and six familiar favorites. Its weather is mild — two of its on-reveal cards are shocks.

marketDecks.name: Many Hats Fair
marketDecks.blurb: A hiring fair for every trade: ten new halls that ready, retrain and rehire, and six familiar favorites. Its weather is mild — three of its on-reveal cards are shocks.

marketDecks.name: Night Market
marketDecks.blurb: The town after dark: an all-night café that wakes the workshop, an observatory that reads the Market Deck, a comet the whole square stops to watch, and lanterns over familiar stalls. Its weather is mild — two of its on-reveal cards are shocks.
